notes: Explicitly a Tower Defense build, so Strategy leads; the six bosses, targeting modes, upgrade tiers and difficulty voting are all systems layered on the same defended lane, so no second genre is doing layout work. Shape is lane-actor-track — the answer pins one clearly defined lane per map with no branching, entry point to end point, and that single-valid-route requirement is the non-negotiable P6. P4 is earned twice over: exactly five maps in five different settings, plus a lobby whose elevators teleport players out to the match. Decided without a user: cover-los covers the 'diferentes obstáculos e elementos ambientais' and the invalid-placement areas each map is asked for, since it is the option that expresses map geometry limiting what a single tower position can reach; the five named settings and the six-boss count are dressing and gameplay respectively, and up to four players share one medium-length lane per the answers.
